Check that `variables.tf` has two complete `variable` blocks — one for `bucket_name` and one for `instance_type`. Each needs `type`, `description`, and `default`.
The `bucket_name` variable needs a `validation` block inside it. The `condition` should evaluate to `false` when the string is empty — `length(var.bucket_name) > 0` is one way to express that.

In `main.tf`, the `bucket` argument of `aws_s3_bucket.assets` should read `var.bucket_name`, and `instance_type` of `aws_instance.app` should read `var.instance_type`. In `terraform.tfvars`, add a line: `bucket_name = "my-learn-assets-2024"`.
